UN Security Council Resolution 2812 (2026)

Extension of the reporting request in para. 10 of resolution 2722 (2024) on Houthi attacks on merchant and commercial vessels in the Red Sea until 15 July 2026

Ukraine and fragmentation · Middle East · Yemen

Not unanimous
Yes 13No 0Abstained 2

United Nations S/RES/2812 (2026) Security Council Distr.: General 14 January 2026

Resolution 2812 (2026) Adopted by the Security Council at its 10089th meeting, on 14 January 2026

The Security Council, Recalling all its relevant resolutions on the situation in Yemen and the Red Sea, including resolutions 2216 (2015), 2722 (2024), 2739 (2024), 2768 (2025), and 2787 (2025),

1. Extends the reporting request in paragraph 10 of resolution 2722 (2024) through July 15, 2026.
